description: Trigger evals for problem-framing: it fires when an objective is fuzzy or possibly mis-scoped and should be shaped into a BRIEF.md before any task folder exists, while task-init, decision-interview, targeted-questions and project-bootstrap handle a clear objective or hotfix, an in-task decision, missing facts, and a brand-new project.

should_trigger: we want to make onboarding better, not sure what that means yet. Help me figure out if that's even the right problem before we start anything.
My manager said 'the dashboard is too slow' and that's all I have. I haven't opened a task. Can you question this with me and turn it into a brief?
I keep saying we need a notifications system but I suspect the real issue is something else. Grill me a bit first.
idea: rebuild the whole admin panel. worth it? shape this before I commit to anything
Before I create any task folder for the 'improve search' request from sales, walk me through one question at a time and write down problem, success criteria and non-goals.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Add a 'last login' column to the users table in the admin list. Start the work.
Production is throwing 500s on /orders since the deploy. Open a task for the hotfix.
The task is already running and we can't decide whether soft-deleted accounts keep their API keys. Ask me the decision questions.
I need to know which Node version and which region the staging cluster runs on before I can plan. Ask me what you need to know.
New client engagement starting Monday. Create the project folder, charter and references skeleton.
